plan.scope: Cycle19 exploratory reanalysis of cycle18same20outputs; not new independent samples
plan.hypothesis: Bar-scale recurrence/variation can carry information distinct from adjacent same-pitch rate; timingcontext may change those descriptors without guaranteeing appeal.

plan.metrics: For eachnonemptybarpair: exact rhythm(offset,gate), exact relativepitch sequence(p-firstpitch), exact full(offset,gate,p-firstpitch), normalized Levenshtein relativepitch similarity; also onsetcountCV acrossall8bars.
plan.denominators: Exclude anypair with anemptybar; report countandrate, nonadjacentpairs separately. Empty/single-onset bars explicitly counted. No empty-empty recurrence.

plan.analysis: Per-output values, equal-output condition means with denominators, pairedseed differences, exploratory Pearson with adjacent samepitch. No statistical significance or outcome selection.
